name: proofline
description: An evidence-first AI investigator that knows when it cannot verify a claim.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API,AGENT -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:agent"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @proofline/contracts && npm run build -w @proofline/web && npm run build -w @proofline/api
scripts.build:sites: npm run build -w @proofline/contracts && npm run build -w @proofline/web && node scripts/package-static-site.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @proofline/api && npm run test -w @proofline/web && npm run test:sites
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @proofline/web && npm run lint -w @proofline/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @proofline/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @proofline/web && npm run typecheck -w @proofline/api
